title: San Ti Duanpian Ji: Pingxing Zhi Jing
synopsis:
Based on the vast science-fiction universe created by Liu Cixin, Three-Body Animated Anthology: Parallel Realms brings together six animated short films, each with its own distinct style and self-contained story. Drawing on the original work’s philosophical fables, gaps in history, and visions of the future, the anthology creates new narratives that explore the choices people make under extreme conditions and expand the visual possibilities of Chinese-style science fiction.

(Source: Bilibili)
